# Proto-Feline
Much like the Protogen-Cyclopses, they also took on a name that distances themselves from their own race- coming up with the distinction all on their own. It's not very.. Creative.
## Racial Features - Their blood has a dark red color. - They are more frail, [color=#ffa500]falling into crit at 85 damage and dying at 170 damage[/color]. - However, they receive [color=#B9BF93](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They can run [color=lightgreen]25%[/color] faster than humans [color=yellow]when not wearing shoes[/color]. They run [color=lightgreen]5%[/color] faster when wearing shoes. - Their claws deal [color=red]3[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks but attack twice as fast. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they can withstand temperatures between -15 and 50 degrees Celcius.
## Weapon Knockback Resomi are incredibly lightweight, and thus they have difficulty using weapons that are any bigger than pistols or SMGs. Shooting any other weapon will cause them to take stamina damage and get pushed back. Rocket launchers, since they are recoil-less, will actually [color=red]pull Resomi forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. Stamina resistance will help mitigate some of the effects of knockback, but will never completely negate it.
## Nekomimetic and Trinary The Felionoid language, known as Nekomimetic, is composed of a series of meows and trills. It is described as an incomprehensible mess that is oddly similar to broken Human Japanese and is thus somewhat easy to learn for other species. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Felionoids have a lifespan similar to that of humans, reaching adulthood at 18 years of age and living up to 140 years. Their names may change several times throughout their lives and they are composed of a prefix, usually related to nature, an action or an atribute, followed by a suffix, usually related to the prefix or nature.
